episode.observation: An exact smooth pressure-free NSE shear has strictly increasing localized kinetic energy on a fixed interior interval.

diagnosis.statement: The generic local-energy identity and pressure localization do not themselves impose a one-sided sign; viscous/cutoff transport can feed a localization even when pressure and convective cutoff flux vanish.

failures.scope: generic exact smooth/local-suitable NSE local-energy/pressure-only monotonicity
hostile shear has infinite global energy and A(r)~r, hence cannot be transferred to the Albritton-Barker finite-I ancient class

obstruction.statement: A+C+D+E are nonnegative magnitude coordinates; the generic local balance supplies no intrinsic signed/no-return coordinate. Any positive route must exploit a specifically finite-I global/trajectory theorem or introduce a separately verified signed observable.

candidate_lesson.trigger: proposal of local pressure magnitude/coherence as a universal no-recrossing source
candidate_lesson.action: first test an exact p=0 shear/local-energy calibration; if recrossing survives, require a finite-I-specific signed coordinate rather than more pressure magnitude bounds
candidate_lesson.falsifier: a source-valid theorem deriving the required sign directly from finite-I plus the standard ledger would supersede this routing lesson in that scope
candidate_lesson.boundary: does not blacklist pressure-dependent finite-I theorems or pressure-coupled signed fluxes

motif.statement: exact PDE simplification can isolate a suspected sign source by setting pressure and nonlinearity to zero while preserving local boundary transport
